mainEntity.name: How is functional fitness different from traditional weightlifting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Functional fitness differs from traditional weightlifting by emphasizing multi-joint, multi-muscle movements that relate to daily tasks and athletic performance, rather than isolating single muscles. While traditional weightlifting often focuses on building muscle mass for aesthetic or competitive purposes, functional fitness aims to improve how your body works as a whole, enhancing coordination and practical strength. When choosing between them, consider whether your primary goal is specialized muscle development or overall physical readiness for life's demands.
acceptedAnswer.description: Functional fitness emphasizes movements for daily tasks and overall physical performance, unlike traditional weightlifting which often isolates single muscles for mass.
